source_claim: AlphaEvolve parallelizes expensive candidate evaluation and runs an asynchronous controller, LLM sampler, and evaluator-node pipeline optimized for throughput; Section 2.4 describes spending on the order of 100 compute-hours on a new solution while parallelism preserves generation cadence for consecutive mutations
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has runtime reporting for configured local stage sample-worker fan-out, observed wall-clock compression, and distributed-pipeline topology linkage, but does not claim AlphaEvolve-style 100-compute-hour candidate budgets, generation-cadence preservation under slow feedback, per-candidate compute-hour budgets, candidate-level async evaluator queues, distributed evaluator nodes, randomized initialization shards, mutation-chain depth impact under slow feedback, pending-work resume, or equal-budget parallelism reports.
